start.title: The Verdict
start.text:
Pilate washes his hands of you.
The crowd roars: "Crucify him!"

choices.feedback: Not curses. The cup is yours.
You bow your head in peace.
The Father's will is the verdict.

curse_consequence.title: No Curse, Only Cup
curse_consequence.text:
Even now, love is your answer.
Receive what the Father gives.

choices.feedback: You bow your head in peace.

plead_consequence.title: The Cup Is Mine
plead_consequence.text:
You came for this hour.
Do not turn from it now.

choices.feedback: You set your face like flint.

carrying.title: The Weight of the Beam
carrying.text:
Rough wood bites your shoulder.
The road to Golgotha rises ahead.

choices.feedback: One step. Then another.

choices.text: Carry it step by trembling step
choices.feedback: You move forward in silent love.

choices.text: Rage at the soldiers around you
choices.feedback: Strength is in surrender now.

drop_consequence.title: One Step More
drop_consequence.text:
Every step is a gift you give.
Lift the wood and walk.

choices.text: Carry it step by trembling step
choices.feedback: Your feet press into the dust.

rage_consequence.title: Strength in Surrender
rage_consequence.text:
Wrath would shatter the sacrifice.
Walk in quiet power instead.

choices.text: Carry it step by trembling step
choices.feedback: You breathe and step forward.

simon_scene.title: A Stranger's Shoulder
simon_scene.text:
You stumble. Soldiers seize Simon.
They force him to share the beam.

choices.feedback: Receive his help with grace.

choices.text: Wave him off and walk alone
choices.feedback: Love does not refuse help.

choices.text: Meet his eyes with quiet thanks
choices.feedback: Simon's strength carries you on.

shame_consequence.title: Receive the Help
shame_consequence.text:
Even the Savior leans on kindness.
Let him bear the wood with you.

choices.text: Meet his eyes with quiet thanks
choices.feedback: Simon nods and walks beside you.

alone_consequence.title: No One Walks Alone
alone_consequence.text:
Pride hides under solitary pain.
Accept the hand the Father sends.

choices.text: Meet his eyes with quiet thanks
choices.feedback: The weight lifts a little.

golgotha.title: The Place of the Skull
golgotha.text:
The hill rises grey and bare.
Soldiers lay the cross at your feet.

choices.text: Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: You taste the cup fully, unclouded.

choices.text: Drink to dull the pain to come
choices.feedback: The cup must be drunk awake.
This hill is your throne.

drink_consequence.title: Awake to the End
drink_consequence.text:
Love refuses the easier path.
Drink only the Father's cup.

choices.text: Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: You shake your head and rise.

turn_back_consequence.title: This Is the Throne
turn_back_consequence.text:
The hill is where mercy is made.
Climb the last steps.

choices.text: Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: You walk to the wood waiting.

nailed.title: Father, Forgive Them
nailed.text:
Iron drives through wrist and foot.
Soldiers gamble for your robe.

choices.text: Cry out a curse upon them
choices.feedback: Mercy speaks louder than wrath.
Your prayer falls like rain.

choices.text: Plead one last time for freedom
choices.feedback: Stay. The work is being done.

nail_curse_consequence.title: Mercy, Not Wrath
nail_curse_consequence.text:
From the cross, only love.
Speak forgiveness, even now.

choices.feedback: The soldiers fall silent below.

plead_free_consequence.title: The Work Is Being Done
plead_free_consequence.text:
Freedom for the world is here.
Not in escape, but in this hour.

choices.feedback: Your voice carries down the hill.

criminals.title: Two on Either Side
criminals.text:
One thief mocks you in his pain.
The other whispers, "Remember me."

choices.feedback: Answer hatred with grace.
A penitent heart deserves answer.
Paradise opens for the broken.

mock_consequence.title: Grace, Not Scorn
mock_consequence.text:
The cross is no place for mockery.
Let mercy be your only voice.

choices.feedback: The thief weeps and breathes deep.

ignore_consequence.title: Answer the Penitent
ignore_consequence.text:
A whispered faith must be met.
Speak the promise of paradise.

choices.feedback: Hope blooms beside your cross.

mary_below.title: Mother and Beloved
mary_below.text:
Your mother stands below in tears.
John holds her trembling shoulder.

choices.feedback: Their pain deserves your gaze.

choices.text: Curse the day you were born
choices.feedback: Bless, do not curse, even now.
John draws Mary close to himself.

look_away_consequence.title: See Them
look_away_consequence.text:
Even on the cross, you give.
Give them to each other.

choices.feedback: Their tears soften into love.

curse_birth_consequence.title: Bless, Not Curse
curse_birth_consequence.text:
You were born for this hour.
Bless the ones still standing.

choices.feedback: Mary lifts her eyes to you.

final_breath.title: It Is Finished
final_breath.text:
The sky darkens. Your strength fails.
One last breath waits inside you.

choices.feedback: End in trust, not in fury.

choices.text: Beg the Father to undo it
choices.feedback: The yes was spoken in the garden.
Peace rushes through the dark.

scream_consequence.title: End in Trust
scream_consequence.text:
Wrath cannot finish the work.
Only surrender can.

choices.feedback: Your breath softens into peace.

undo_consequence.title: Already Yes
undo_consequence.text:
The garden's yes still holds.
Let the body follow the heart.

choices.feedback: Quiet floods the hill.

ending.title: It Is Finished
ending.text:
The veil tears. The earth trembles.
Your breath gives way to love itself.
